title: Design System: Winning Adventure Global — The Factory Floor Edition

shadows.name: lead-form
shadows.purpose: Persistent shadow on the inline lead form.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Navy background, white text, square corners. Used for main CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0F2D5E; color: #fff; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1A4A8A; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C97A0A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button (Amber)
components.description: Amber background, navy text. Used sparingly for Book Free Consult.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #C97A0A; color: #0F2D5E; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #D97706; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0F2D5E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent with 1px navy border. For secondary navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #0F2D5E; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 16px 24px; border: 1px solid #0F2D5E; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(15,45,94,0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C97A0A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Lead Form
components.description: 3-field lead capture: name, email, sourcing need.
components.html:
Book your free consult
Your details go to our Australia-based team.
components.css: .ds-lead-form { background: #fff; padding: 24px 32px; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(15,45,94,0.18); } .ds-lf-header { font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; color: #0F2D5E; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 15px; color: #0F2D5E; margin-bottom: 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0F2D5E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(201,122,10,0.4); } .ds-btn-full { width: 100%; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-lf-foot { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(15,45,94,0.5); text-align: center; margin-top: 12px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Default form input with amber-on-navy focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-demo { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 15px; color: #0F2D5E; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input-demo::placeholder { color: rgba(15,45,94,0.4); } .ds-input-demo:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0F2D5E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(201,122,10,0.4); }

narrative.overview: The visual system treats every interaction as part of an efficient, trustworthy industrial process — clean, direct, no wasted motion. Deep navy (#0F2D5E) carries authority and stability; amber (#C97A0A) provides a warm, energetic accent used sparingly. IBM Plex Sans (UI clarity) and IBM Plex Serif (editorial warmth) form the typographic backbone.
keyCharacteristics: Flat by default, tactile on interaction (cards lift on hover, buttons nudge up)
Copy is the design — clarity over cleverness, every element earns its place
Hero images are real CC0 industrial/shipping photography, not generic stock
Color tells hierarchy: white text is normal, amber is italic-emphasized
Journey-aware for anxious first-time China sourcers

rules.name: The Amber-Italic Rule
rules.body: Theme-colored words in the hero slogan are amber italic; all surrounding words are white normal weight.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as interaction feedback.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: System text uses 400 or 600 only. No 300, no 700 beyond headings.

rules.name: The Tonal-Layer Rule
rules.body: Section backgrounds alternate between white and #F8F9FB to create rhythm.

dos: Use navy for primary headings, buttons, and hero backgrounds.
Use amber for CTAs and single-word emphasis in hero text.
Keep the hero color-split pattern: white = normal, amber = italic.
Use CC0 industrial/shipping photography with navy gradient overlay.
Maintain 44px minimum touch targets on all interactive elements.
Use 'Book Free Consult' as the site-wide primary CTA.
Use scroll-mt-20 on any section with an id anchor.
donts: Use 'WAG' or 'WA' abbreviations — always 'Winning Adventure Global'.
Use emoji anywhere in the frontend codebase.
Use academic reference lists on landing pages.
Use the eyebrow (tiny uppercase tracked label) as every-section scaffolding.
